description: CTIO BLANK represents the general pool of broad-band and narrow-band optical filters used on the Blanco 4-meter and other telescopes at CTIO, including Harris, Tektronix, Washington, Strömgren, and Gunn filter sets.
short_description: CTIO general filter pool (BLANK) for the Blanco 4-m and others
facility_description: The Víctor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope is operated at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) in Chile as a program of NSF NOIRLab.
notes: CTIO BLANK includes optical standard and interference filters used with various prime-focus and Cassegrain instruments at the Blanco telescope. Curves are from NOIRLab observatory records without an open redistribution licence.
